Avigdor Lieberman, leader of the right-wing Yisrael Beiteinu party, will be the Israeli parliament’s chairman, the Knesset’s Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee said on Monday. Tibi is the leader of the Ta’al Party, which is part of the Joint List.
